review_findings_resolved.finding: ExileUntilLeavesExecutor skips exile after the source departs, which is wrong for separate old-style linked triggers.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Existing ExileLinkedToSource routes to MoveToZoneEffectExecutor and LinkedExileLookup, retaining the original battlefield visit; leave-before-exile regression authored.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Author identified that CostPaymentService ReturnToHand excludes the source even if the Hawk has become an artifact.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Existing pipeline gathers controlled artifacts including self, chooses up to one without rules targeting, and branches on selection; actual Ashnod Transmogrant artifactification regression authored.

review_findings_resolved.finding: SacrificeSelfExecutor reads physical sourceId and ignores sourceReferenceLost, risking sacrifice of a returned new Hawk object by an old ETB.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Empty branch now uses Effects.SacrificeTarget(EffectTarget.Self), which resolves current object identity and controller; actual Momentary Blink/old-ETB regression authored.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Initial fixtures manually patched RNG after build and unsuccessful wrapper-state checks did not establish returned-state atomicity.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Existing ScenarioBuilder.withRngSeed used; rejection cases now inspect returned ExecutionResult.state as well as error.

composition_review.Crypt Rats: Existing restricted X mana, all-creature iteration including own creatures and flying creatures, and player damage; nine authored tests include zero damage, Toxin totals, queued activation, and low-life lifelink.
composition_review.Glint Hawk: Non-targeting resolution choice, source-inclusive artifact domain, ownership-sensitive return, token handling, stale-source-safe sacrifice.
composition_review.Kor Skyfisher: Mandatory exactly-one controlled permanent choice at resolution, no rules targeting, land and self eligible, owner hand destination.
composition_review.Journey to Nowhere: Separate linked ETB/LTB effects with original-source-visit lookup, target revalidation, owner control, and token invalidation.
composition_review.Witch's Cottage: Other-Swamp threshold in entry replacement; actual untapped entry restricts triggering only, so later tapping does not cancel the trigger; optional targeted graveyard-to-top return.

limitations: This review is static source and authored-scenario inspection, not executed rules qualification or gameplay evidence.

Canonical placement and reprint rows were structurally reviewed. Author separately supplies original-printing re-fetches and image checks; the repository printing command, compile, scenario, snapshots, and Assay gates remain pending.

Crypt Rats per-recipient damage composition can establish ordinary damage and lifelink totals under tested conditions; these tests do not establish universal simultaneous-event grouping for every lifegain trigger or batch-sensitive redirect effect.
